decisions.text: The 2028 season is over. Keep playing as Drew Rogers, switch to one of the juniors entering the world for 2029 (chosen on 1 January, after the winter; Drew Rogers carries on under AI control through the winter), or end the career.

facts.detail: You make Drew Rogers's winter choices next (career path, staff, residence).
Drew Rogers returns to AI control now, before the winter: the AI makes all their winter decisions. On 1 January 2029 you choose one of 10 juniors entering the world (they exist whoever you choose).
Every golfer is under AI control from now on. This cannot be undone.
